newsitem.title: GERMANY: German girl dead, police see link to second murder.
newsitem.headline: German girl dead, police see link to second murder.

text.p: The body of a 10-year-old German girl missing since August was found in a forest near the eastern town of Jena and police said on Wednesday they suspected a link to the murder last week of another girl of the same age.
The corpse of 10-year-old Ramona Krauss was found in woodland after a hunter had come across pieces of clothing and her school book bag.

State prosecutor Holm Kastel told journalists the murderer might also be the killer of Kim Kerkow, who disappeared last Thursday from her home in the north German town of Varel and was found dead on Friday in woods outside Amsterdam.
Kastel said a car similar to a black BMW seen in Varel before Kerkow disappeared had also been spotted in Jena.
German police have appealed to the public to help find the rare BMW 850 luxury model, but so far without success.
Last September, Germans were horrified by the rape and murder of a seven-year-old Bavarian schoolgirl, Natalie Astner, by a convicted sex felon who had recently been released from detention.
The case prompted calls for chemical castration of paedophiles, stiffer sentencing and an end to early releases for sex offenders.
